[id="disk-config-exclusion"]
=== Config Drive Handling During Migration

When migrating instances from VMware to OpenStack, OS Migrate automatically excludes the `disk.config` file from the migration process. This file represents the Nova config drive, which is regenerated by the destination OpenStack cloud.

The migration process identifies and transfers the following disk types:

* Root disk (`disk`)
* Ephemeral disks (`disk.eph0`, `disk.eph1`, etc.)

The following files are explicitly excluded:

* `disk.info` - Metadata files
* `disk.config` - Config drive (regenerated by destination cloud)

This ensures that the destination cloud creates a fresh config drive with appropriate configuration for the new environment, rather than copying potentially incompatible configuration from the source.
